related.title: FFTW：正反變換與正規化
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付CSR表、逐項乘積與邊界索引測試；1/−1正確，rowptr單調、末值等於nnz且列索引在向量範圍；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver CSR tables, entry products and index-boundary tests. Verify 1/−1, monotonic rowptr, last=nnz and valid column bounds. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫輸入、正向頻譜、反向輸出及1/N步驟，註明複數實虛部與方向符號；24/48及還原3一致，報告含DFT符號、長度、stride與縮放。
related.differenceEn: Draw the input, forward spectrum, inverse output, and 1/N scaling step. Label real and imaginary parts and transform signs. Verify 24/48 and recovered 3 with sign, length, stride and scaling documented.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: CSR一列y_i=sum values[k]×x[col[k]]；rowptr界定半開區間，零可不儲存；第0列col=[0,2]、values=[2,−1]，x=[3,4,5]；將x2改7；名義式 2*3-1*5 = 1 y[0]；變更式 2*3-1*7 = -1 y[0]。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
未正規化的正反DFT合成得到N×x；還原時需明確除N，而非假設函式庫自動除；合成N8，原始單元素x=3；改N16，同樣只觀察對應元素的正反合成；名義式 8*3 = 24 unnormalized reconstructed value；變更式 16*3 = 48 unnormalized reconstructed value。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: CSR row y_i sums values[k] x[col[k]] over a rowptr half-open interval; zeros may be omitted. Row 0 columns [0, 2], values [2, −1], x [3, 4, 5]; change x 2 to 7. Nominal 2*3-1*5 = 1 y[0]; changed 2*3-1*7 = -1 y[0]. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

Unnormalized forward/inverse DFTs compose to N×x; recovery explicitly divides by N. Synthetic N 8, original element x 3; compare N 16 at the same forward-inverse element. Nominal 8*3 = 24 unnormalized reconstructed value; changed 16*3 = 48 unnormalized reconstructed value. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: LAMMPS：鄰居清單 skin 與重建安全
related.titleEn: LAMMPS: neighbor skins and rebuild checks
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付CSR表、逐項乘積與邊界索引測試；1/−1正確，rowptr單調、末值等於nnz且列索引在向量範圍；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver CSR tables, entry products and index-boundary tests. Verify 1/−1, monotonic rowptr, last=nnz and valid column bounds. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫力截距、鄰居截距和兩粒子相向移動，記位置更新前後與清單建立時刻；10/15可重算，記相對位移理由且不把安全邊界當建議最大性能設定。
related.differenceEn: Draw force and neighbor cutoffs with two approaching particles. Record position updates and the list construction time. Reproduce 10 and 15 with the relative-motion rationale. Do not present the boundary as an optimized production setting.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: CSR一列y_i=sum values[k]×x[col[k]]；rowptr界定半開區間，零可不儲存；第0列col=[0,2]、values=[2,−1]，x=[3,4,5]；將x2改7；名義式 2*3-1*5 = 1 y[0]；變更式 2*3-1*7 = -1 y[0]。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。

保守教學判準為每粒子移動不超skin/2，因兩粒子可能相向；不是所有設定的唯一重建規則；合成skin=.4距離單位，速度上限.02單位/步；改skin=.6，速度固定；名義式 (.4/2)/.02 = 10 steps to half-skin displacement；變更式 (.6/2)/.02 = 15 steps to half-skin displacement。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: CSR row y_i sums values[k] x[col[k]] over a rowptr half-open interval; zeros may be omitted. Row 0 columns [0, 2], values [2, −1], x [3, 4, 5]; change x 2 to 7. Nominal 2*3-1*5 = 1 y[0]; changed 2*3-1*7 = -1 y[0]. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

A conservative teaching criterion limits each particle to half the skin because two particles can approach each other. Actual policies have additional conditions. Synthetic skin = 0.4 distance units and maximum motion = 0.02 units per step; compare skin = 0.6 at the same motion rate. Nominal (.4/2)/.02 = 10 steps to half-skin displacement; changed (.6/2)/.02 = 15 steps to half-skin displacement. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
